details:
Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A) The review/autofix pipeline (`review_autofix.yml` and its scripts)
B) The orchestrator poller and judges (`orchestrate_poll.yml`, `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`)
C) The clarify/plan/implement phase workflows
D) Documentation only (README, `agents.d/` fragments, docs/)
E) None of these: close this issue and file a new one that describes a specific problem or goal (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What kind of improvement is wanted?
Choices:
A) Fix a specific bug or failure (give the run link, error or symptom)
B) Reduce cost, runtime or GitHub API usage (name the workflow or metric)
C) Add or change a feature (describe the behaviour you want)
D) Close this issue, because it has no actionable request (RECOMMENDED)
Q3: How will we know the change is done?
Choices:
A) A named test or check passes, or a named failure stops happening (state which one)
B) A named metric changes by a stated amount (state the metric and the target)
C) No criterion can be given yet: close the issue until one can be stated (RECOMMENDED)
